capabilities: convert .docx, .pptx and .pdf files to Markdown via right-click menu or command palette
extract embedded images as attachments and insert references
convert Word and PowerPoint tables to Markdown tables
split PDFs into per-page sections with paragraph detection
insert converted output at the cursor or save it as a new .md file with a naming template
extras: README notes PDF conversion is text-only (image extraction for PDFs is on the roadmap), and the manifest carries an unreviewed-plugin warning. Fully local: no network requests or telemetry.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to convert .docx, .pptx or .pdf documents into Markdown notes with images and tables preserved.
summary: File converter that turns Word, PowerPoint and PDF files into Markdown notes inside Obsidian, extracting images and tables.
